capabilities: Chat with ACP-compatible agents from inside the vault
Mention notes with @ so agents can read and edit them
Run multiple agent sessions in sidebar tabs, editor tabs, floating windows, and embedded chat blocks
Approve or reject agent permission prompts and view word-level diffs of note edits
Export conversations as Markdown notes with frontmatter
extras: Desktop-only plugin that launches local agents as child processes and lets them run terminal commands; security notes stress that agents have full system access and auto-allow permissions is off by default. Pre-release versions available via BRAT; full documentation is hosted externally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to converse with local AI agents and let them read, edit, and act on vault notes without copy-pasting.

relations.evidence: Built on the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) by Zed.
Chat with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and any ACP agent right in Obsidian
Chat with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and any ACP agent right in Obsidian

requires.name: a locally installed ACP agent (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI)
agent authentication/API keys stored in Obsidian's Keychain

summary: Chat client for ACP-compatible agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, with @-mentions that let agents read and edit vault notes.
